places.name: Shillong Peak Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint offering panoramic views of Shillong and the surrounding hills.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during clear weather.

places.place_tip: Carry a camera to capture the stunning views.

places.name: Umiam Lake
places.ai_summary: A serene man-made lake surrounded by lush greenery, perfect for boating and picnics.

opening_hours.notes: Boating facilities available.

places.place_tip: Visit during sunrise for a tranquil experience.

places.name: Elephant Falls
places.ai_summary: A picturesque waterfall surrounded by lush greenery, divided into three tiers.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the monsoon season.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes as the path can be slippery.

places.name: Nohkalikai Falls (Cherrapunji)
places.ai_summary: The tallest plunge waterfall in India, located in the picturesque village of Cherrapunji.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the monsoon season for full water flow.

places.place_tip: View the falls from the designated viewpoint for safety.

places.name: Living Root Bridges (Nongriat)
places.ai_summary: Unique bridges made from the roots of rubber trees, located in the village of Nongriat.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Trek to the bridges early in the morning for a peaceful experience.

places.place_tip: Carry waterproof clothing and gear.

places.name: Laitlum Canyon
places.ai_summary: A stunning canyon offering breathtaking views, especially during sunrise and sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, as there are no facilities nearby.

places.name: Seven Sisters Falls
places.ai_summary: A beautiful waterfall located on the outskirts of Shillong, especially stunning during the monsoon.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the monsoon season.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the serene beauty.

places.name: Mawlynnong (Cleanest Village)
places.ai_summary: Known as the cleanest village in Asia, Mawlynnong is a model of eco-tourism and cleanliness.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for a peaceful experience.

places.place_tip: Respect the local customs and contribute to the cleanliness.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a local guide.

places.place_tip: Do not disturb the sacred sites and follow the local customs.

places.name: Ward’s Lake
places.ai_summary: A beautiful artificial lake in Shillong, ideal for picnics and boating.

opening_hours.notes: Boating charges extra.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a boat ride on the lake for a relaxing experience.

places.name: Police Bazaar Market
places.ai_summary: The main market in Shillong, offering a variety of local products, handicrafts, and street food.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for street food.

places.place_tip: Bargain for handicrafts and try the local street food.

places.name: Sweet Falls
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and serene waterfall, perfect for a quiet retreat into nature.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the monsoon season.

places.place_tip: Carry a picnic and enjoy the serene environment.
